hypothesis: A regularized joint classifier of complementary base-model evidence can improve attribution beyond the frozen equal-weight v3 ensemble.
base_normalization: Existing normalize_evidence: log clipped probabilities when applicable, then per-row mean-zero unit-standard-deviation evidence.

meta.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only on meta-training rows

nested_evaluation.inner_folds: The other four saved folds; each inner fit excludes its validation fold and the outer held-out fold.
nested_evaluation.pair_cache: Ten unordered excluded-fold pairs; each fit may predict both excluded folds, with predictions routed separately.
nested_evaluation.cached_original_outer_oof: Allowed only after exact producer, row, class, fold, configuration and source provenance verification.

candidate_pooling: Normalize stacked probabilities with normalize_evidence, then combine with the unrenormalized mean of the three frozen v3 component evidence matrices.
selection: Choose the highest pooled original-fold balanced accuracy among exactly these two candidates; break ties in favor of stack. No parameter or weight sweep.

robustness.baseline: Frozen scored v3, evaluated using the same newly fitted outer components

runtime_fit: Generate five prompt-group OOF folds with seed 42 inside fit, train the meta classifier on these predictions, and refit each base on all training rows.
limitations: All labeled data has been used in earlier development. These are robustness checks, not untouched holdouts.
Selecting the better of two candidates introduces selection optimism.
A validation gain does not guarantee a public or private leaderboard gain.
